note: Types a ratification batch considered and did not admit. PROPOSE reads this as a veto set so it never re-proposes a type already ruled out by name. Recovered from the 'Rejected, and deliberately absent from this table' prose in the per-cohort identity and admission fragments that issue #96 deleted (readable at d40d9f5ded^) and from live/e2e/estates/remainder/README.md; recovered_from names the source each type came from. THE INVARIANT: this set and internal/live/identity.DefaultTable are disjoint. A type that is admitted must not be vetoed, because two contradictory rulings are not conservatism. TestRejectedLedgerIsDisjointFromAdmitted enforces it. Issue #131 rebuilt the ledger against that invariant: the first recovery harvested every type name adjacent to the word Rejected rather than the subject of each '- <type>:' bullet, which admitted 58 types into the veto set and lost 5 genuine rejections. Over-inclusion is safe only among types nobody admitted; among admitted types it is a defect.

aws_apigatewayv2_route.reason: verifies as a two-component composite, not the flat server-assigned row row-gen's classifier proposed: the provider's own Identity Schema (v6.59.0) names api_id AND id both Required, and api_id is a plain Required argument on the resource itself ("API identifier"). The classifier's import-grammar-precedence rule saw the doc's own prose attribute the id segment to the Attribute Reference and concluded the WHOLE two-segment identity is server-assigned, dropping api_id even though it is a real, config-supplied argument on this same resource - the exact 'second required, config-supplied component ignored' risk this ledger exists to catch. Left unadmitted; belongs with its apigatewayv2_*/api_gateway_* sibling family (needs hand separator), which also needs the not-yet-built parent-scoped Cloud Control listing capability.

aws_appstream_directory_config.reason: credential material: service_account_credentials.account_password is a Required plaintext AD service-account password persisted in config and state (provider doc 6.59.0, Argument Reference); same class as aws_ivs_playback_key_pair's client-supplied write-only material. Ruled by the maintainer 2026-08-15 (#175); the one class where rejection is the end state.

aws_appsync_api_key.reason: verifies as needing a config-supplied api_id component the classifier's flat server-assigned proposal dropped: the provider's Import section requires "AppSync API ID and key separated by :", and api_id is a plain Required argument on this resource. The classifier's generic 'primaryIdentifier subset of readOnlyProperties' rule fired because CFN's own primaryIdentifier is the single field ApiKeyId, so it never considered the doc's two-segment requirement even though it printed the two-segment ImportSyntax placeholder itself. Untaggable and unlistable (live/survey-full.json), so there is no discovery fallback either. Left unadmitted.

aws_appsync_function.reason: verifies as needing a config-supplied api_id component the classifier's flat server-assigned proposal dropped: the provider's Import section requires "AppSync API ID and Function ID separated by -", and api_id is a plain Required argument on this resource. Same generic-rule gap as aws_appsync_api_key. Left unadmitted.
